glossEn: (botany) a plant that completes its entire life cycle within the space of a year
note: (botany) a plant that completes its entire life cycle within a year。名词义。现有中文无对应，属新增。植物学义，造句须带 plant/botany 语境。

glossEn: a reference book that is published regularly once every year
note: a reference book that is published regularly once every year。线索：the annual report / an annual publication。「年报」是它的子类型。

glossEn: completing its life cycle within a year
note: completing its life cycle within a year。形容词义，专指植物。现有中文无对应，属新增。与 s4 的判别句：an annual plant（一年生）/ an annual meeting（年度）。

glossZh: 每年的，一年一次的；全年的
note: occurring or payable every year。线索：annual report / annual income / annual leave。**本词最常用的义**。
